# haruhimemoe

> haruhimemoe is the GitHub organization behind haruhime.moe, a small set of tools for osu! tournament organization and production. It holds the packs.haruhime.moe pack builder, the pools.haruhime.moe mappool search (in beta), the haruhime.moe home page, six TypeScript packages published on npm under the @haruhimemoe scope, and a Claude Code plugin of osu! skills.

One more tool, sheets, is coming soon. It has no public site yet.

Every @haruhimemoe package is ESM only. On Node they need 22.12 or later.

## Tools

- [packs.haruhime.moe](https://packs.haruhime.moe/): Build osu! mappool packs from beatmap IDs or links, download them as one zip or a torrent, and share them with a pack key or a short link.
- [packs.haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://packs.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The packs pages, guides, public packs index and API, in llms.txt format.
- [packs API](https://packs.haruhime.moe/docs/api.md): Read public packs and manage your own from scripts and bots with a personal API key.
- [packs.haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/packs.haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind packs.haruhime.moe.
- [pools.haruhime.moe](https://pools.haruhime.moe/): Past osu! tournament mappools from several sources, a search over every osu! map with unusable maps left out, where each map was played before, and a check of a pool against the content rules for officially supported tournaments. In beta.
- [pools.haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://pools.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The pools pages and where its data comes from, in llms.txt format.
- [pools.haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pools.haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind pools.haruhime.moe.

## Home page

- [haruhime.moe](https://www.haruhime.moe/): haruhime's home page: the osu! tournament tools, thanks, the brand kit, a showcase of @haruhimemoe/ui, contact and a disclaimer.
- [haruhime.moe llms.txt](https://www.haruhime.moe/llms.txt): The home page's pages and tools, in llms.txt format.
- [haruhime.moe source](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/haruhime.moe): The Next.js app behind haruhime.moe.
- [Contact](https://www.haruhime.moe/contact): Email, the Discord server, GitHub, and how to report a security problem privately.

## Packages

- [@haruhimemoe/osu](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/osu): osu! API v2: beatmap, beatmapset and user shapes with zod schemas (browser-safe at `@haruhimemoe/osu/shapes`), and a server client with token caching, a rate-budget hook, beatmaps, beatmapsets and star ratings with mods.
- [@haruhimemoe/pool](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool): osu! tournament mappools as data: slots, mod buckets, custom slots with forced or free mods, zod validation, pure editing helpers, pasted-pool parsing, and the pk1/pk2/pk3 pack key codec.
- [Pack key format](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/pool/blob/main/docs/pack-key.md): The pk1, pk2 and pk3 pack key spec that @haruhimemoe/pool reads and writes, with the decoder rules.
- [@haruhimemoe/compliance](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/compliance): Check osu! beatmapsets against the content rules for officially supported osu! tournaments. A port of hburn7/omc-api's rules, with no network and no dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/hinai](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/hinai): Client for the hinai osu! beatmap mirror (mirror.hinamizawa.ai): difficulty metadata, set availability, and streamed .osz downloads with progress, abort and retry hints. Works in browsers and on servers.
- [@haruhimemoe/ui](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui): React components for the haruhime.moe tools on Next.js: the osu!-web-style palette as a Tailwind theme, buttons, cards, form fields, filter controls, and the site header and footer.
- [@haruhimemoe/ui showcase](https://www.haruhime.moe/ui): Every @haruhimemoe/ui component in its states, rendered on haruhime.moe from the published package.
- [@haruhimemoe/brand](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/brand): Brand kit generator: palettes from one hue, Nunito wordmarks, monogram icons and README banners as outlined SVG, and the PNG icons and link previews Next.js serves as static files.

## npm

- [@haruhimemoe/osu on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/osu): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/osu zod` (zod 4.0.16 or later in 4.x is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/pool on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/pool): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/pool zod` (zod 4.0.16 or later in 4.x is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/compliance on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/compliance): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/compliance`. No dependencies.
- [@haruhimemoe/hinai on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/hinai): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/hinai zod` (zod 4.0.16 or later in 4.x is a peer dependency).
- [@haruhimemoe/ui on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/ui): Install with `bun add @haruhimemoe/ui`. Its peers are Next.js 16, React 19, React DOM 19 and Tailwind CSS 4 (4.1 or later).
- [@haruhimemoe/brand on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@haruhimemoe/brand): Install as a dev dependency with `bun add -d @haruhimemoe/brand`. Ships the `haruhime-brand` CLI.

## Claude Code plugin

- [claude-plugin](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/claude-plugin): The `haruhime` Claude Code plugin: skills for the osu! API v2, the content rules and official support for osu! tournaments, mappool data and pack keys, the hinai mirror, packs.haruhime.moe and its API, haruhime.moe branding and UI components (@haruhimemoe/ui), and the @haruhimemoe packages. Install with `/plugin marketplace add haruhimemoe/claude-plugin`, then `/plugin install haruhime@haruhimemoe`.

## Community

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/bKy9kjMV4y): The haruhime.moe Discord server, for questions and feedback about the tools.
